title: Pāti (2)
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || 3 Idāham bhikkhave ekaccam puggalam evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi || na cāyam āyasmā rūpiyapātiyāpi suvaṇṇacuṇṇaparipūrāya hetu sampajānamusā bhāseyyāti || || 4 Tam enaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtam pariyādiṇṇacittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ || || 5 Evam dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe || || 6 Evañhi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbanti || || Dutiyaṃ || ||
